brief.zh: 使僵尸获得一段时间的中毒效果

description.en: Shadow-shrooms poison zombies who touch them, inflicting damage over time.
description.zh: 毒影菇接触到僵尸时，对其施加毒性效果，中毒僵尸一段时间内持续受到伤害。

chat.en: Despite being such a poisonous and profoundly inedible fungus, Shadow-shroom is nonetheless a total cutie-pie.
chat.zh: 尽管毒影菇是一种有毒且不容易食用的真菌，但他仍然是一道美味的食物。

text.en: powered Shadow-shrooms make poisoned zombies poison other zombies
text.zh: 暗影状态下，使僵尸身上的毒有传染性
